result.description:
Australian Network Services PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Welder and/or Metal Fabricator for our client's construction
industry (residential homes, commercial buildings, and public spaces) across NSW, WA in Australia. On a full-time basis,
you will be part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Welder and/or Metal Fabricator, Full- time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:
Requirements

• Certificate 3 including 2 years’ experience or Certificate 4 in Engineering-Fabrication Trade/(Welding)
• Proven experience as Welder and/or Metal Fabricator for at least 2 years.
• Knowledge of welding techniques and materials.
• Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.
• Physical stamina and strength.
• Attention to detail and precision.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.

Responsibilities
• Interpreting blueprints: Understanding detailed plans to guide fabrication.
• Cutting and shaping metal: Using tools and machinery to cut, bend, and shape metal pieces.
• Welding and joining: Employing different welding techniques to fuse metal parts.
• Inspecting and testing: Ensuring the integrity and quality of the fabricated parts.
• Diagnosing issues: Identifying problems with metal components.
• Performing repairs: Fixing or replacing damaged parts.
• Conducting regular maintenance: Keeping equipment in optimal working condition.
• Adhering to standards: Following industry and safety standards.
• Inspecting finished products: Conducting thorough inspections for defects.
• Documenting processes: Keeping records of fabrication and inspection activities.
• Work closely with engineers, fabricators, and other team members to complete projects
• Communicate effectively with supervisors and colleagues to ensure project requirements are met

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to date CV. We can schedule in
a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to you.
